تمتثلوا (form VIII)
# تَمْتَثِلُوا (tamtaṯilū) /tam.ta.θi.luː/: second-person masculine plural non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِمْتَثَلَ (imtaṯala)
# تُمْتَثَلُوا (tumtaṯalū) /tum.ta.θa.luː/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِمْتَثَلَ (imtaṯala)
